name: aeoora – AI Search SEO, AEO & GEO for ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini & Bing: llms.txt & AI Crawlers
author: codefreex

sections.description:
aeoora is the free, open-source Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and AI SEO plugin for WordPress. Whether you call it AEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), LLMO or LLM SEO, the goal is the same: getting your pages found, trusted and cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot and Google AI Overviews.

Classic SEO plugins optimize for ten blue links. aeoora optimizes for the answer. It shows you which AI crawlers read your site and which AI assistants send you visitors, lets you decide who may use your content, serves AI engines clean llms.txt and Markdown versions of every page, and scores every post for AI-answer readiness. Then it helps you fix what it finds, by hand or with AI.

Why site owners choose aeoora

  • Everything is free, with no account. No sign-up, no API key to start, no credits, no “Pro” version and nothing locked. AI crawler and AI referral tracking run on your own server, with no Google Analytics needed.
  • 325 crawlers recognized, more than any other free WordPress plugin we know of, including AI agents and live AI assistants.
  • Built for the whole site. No 3-page or 50-page caps: llms.txt, scans, audits, suggestions and IndexNow cover every published page, in the background.
  • Set and forget. llms.txt, llms-full.txt and your robots.txt rules are rebuilt when content changes and on a schedule, and stay applied even if another plugin writes its own.
  • Works with what you have. Keeps Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress and your page builder; never duplicates schema or meta tags.
  • Your AI, or none. AI features run on the AI service connected to WordPress, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, a local Ollama model, or aeoora Cloud AI. Or skip AI entirely.

Links: Documentation · What is AEO? · AI search checklist · Support forum · Leave a review

Who it’s for

Bloggers and publishers, WooCommerce stores, SaaS and local businesses, and agencies running AEO for client sites.

Up and running in 2 minutes

Activate the plugin and tracking, llms.txt and Markdown are live immediately. A short guided setup asks who may use your content, who you are and whether to connect AI, then scans your site and shows your score and your three biggest wins.

1. See what AI does with your site

  • 325 crawlers recognized (121 of them AI): AI training bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot), AI search bots (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot), live AI assistants (ChatGPT-User, Claude-User, Perplexity-User), AI agents (including ChatGPT Agent via Signature-Agent), search engines, SEO tools and scrapers.
  • AI referral traffic by assistant: real visitors from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, DeepSeek, Grok, Meta AI, Le Chat, NotebookLM and 30 more, with the pages they land on. Works behind every page cache, with no cookies and no IP addresses stored.
  • Live dashboard, crawl log with CSV export, WordPress dashboard widget and email reports (daily, weekly or monthly).

Learn more: AI crawler analytics · AI referral traffic

2. Control who may use your content

  • Per crawler, choose Allow, Disallow (in robots.txt) or Block (a hard HTTP 403 for bots that ignore robots.txt). Vendor documentation is linked for most crawlers, for example OpenAI’s crawlers.
  • One-click presets: Maximum AI visibility, Get cited, don’t train, Block all AI and Stop scrapers, plus Content Signals and custom rules.
  • Physical robots.txt kept in sync: your rules are written safely into a physical robots.txt (backed up first) and, if you turn it on, re-applied automatically whenever a deploy or another plugin rewrites the file.
  • Compliance warnings for bots that ignore your rules, and a live robots.txt check against what your server or CDN really serves.

Not sure what to allow? Read which AI crawlers to allow.

3. Feed AI engines clean, citable content

  • llms.txt and llms-full.txt, generated in the llmstxt.org format for every page (no size or page caps unless you set one), rebuilt a few minutes after each change and on a schedule (twice a day by default, or hourly or daily).
  • One-click takeover of llms.txt and llms-full.txt: if another plugin or a leftover file serves either one, aeoora shows it, answers both files first, turns off Yoast SEO’s and Rank Math’s llms.txt, moves old files to a backup and re-checks every 10 minutes. “Check what is served” requests the files like a crawler would, and “Undo takeover” puts everything back.
  • A Markdown version of every page: add .md to any URL (/about.md) or use ?format=markdown. Works with any permalink structure, custom post types, WooCommerce, WPML, Polylang and page builders, and strips widgets, share buttons and ads.
  • Never exposes drafts, private, password-protected, noindex or members-only content.
  • Schema without duplicates: FAQPage, Article, Organization, WebSite and BreadcrumbList. aeoora adds only what your SEO plugin does not already output.
  • FAQ and Key-takeaway blocks (and shortcodes) for answer-ready boxes anywhere.
  • IndexNow for instant indexing in Bing (which powers Microsoft Copilot), Yandex, Seznam and Naver, including “Submit every page now”.

4. Improve every page

  • 24-check AI-answer readiness score for every post and page: answer-first intro, question headings, self-contained sections, lists and tables, statistics, cited sources, attributed quotes, definitions, freshness, author expertise (E-E-A-T), original insight, readability and more. The whole site is scored in the background, in small batches, however many pages you have.
  • 18-check site audit, run against your live site: crawler access, content in the server HTML, sitemap dates, HTTPS, canonical tags, response time, Organization schema, llms.txt, Markdown, IndexNow, Bing and author bios.
  • Suggestions you apply in one click: meta descriptions, SEO titles, answer-first intros, FAQs and a prioritized fix list with the points each fix is worth. Review the whole site in batches, or a set number of pages a day. They work without AI; with AI, your model writes them.
  • AI blog writer in a Notion-style editor: brief → outline → article → a real block-editor draft with meta description and FAQ schema. Press / for blocks, drag to reorder, and ask AI to rewrite, expand or shorten any block. It never invents facts: it leaves [STAT NEEDED] and [SOURCE NEEDED] placeholders.
  • 47 AI templates: AI Overview answers, FAQ generator, “questions people ask AI”, comparison tables, pros and cons, voice answers, product descriptions, social posts, rewrites, translations and more.
  • Editor panel in the block and classic editors, with a live score, FAQ, TL;DR, meta fields and AI buttons.

Step-by-step guides: rank in Google AI Overviews · get recommended by ChatGPT · get cited by Perplexity · AEO for WordPress publishers

Choose your AI, or use none

AI is optional. Pick one under aeoora → Settings → AI:

  • aeoora Cloud AI (when this site is connected to aeoora Cloud): included in your plan, no key to manage.
  • WordPress AI (WordPress 7.0+): the service connected under Settings → Connectors.
  • Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: OpenAI, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Mistral, Groq, xAI, Together, and the OpenAI-compatible addresses of Anthropic and Google Gemini.
  • Local Ollama: free models on your own server.

Keys are encrypted at rest, a daily request limit protects your bill, and broken or cut-off AI replies are repaired automatically.

Optional: aeoora Cloud

The plugin shows what happens on your site. aeoora Cloud is a separate, paid hosted service from the same team that shows what AI answers say about you: brand mentions and recommendations in ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, share of voice against competitors, cited sources, a Content Agent and team workspaces. See features and pricing.

Connect in one click: click Connect with aeoora Cloud, sign in and pick your brand. You come back connected: AI-crawler visits flow into your verified crawler report, the tracking snippet counts AI-assistant visits, aeoora Cloud AI becomes available, and (if you allow it) WordPress approves an Application Password so drafts can be sent to your site. Disconnect stops everything at once. Nothing is sent before you connect.

Built to feel like WordPress

Accessible (keyboard, screen readers, WCAG AA contrast, reduced motion, RTL), follows your admin color scheme, adds Ctrl/⌘+K shortcuts and is fully translatable. Hard blocks never touch the REST API, AJAX, cron, login, WooCommerce or payment webhooks.

Works with your theme and plugins

  • SEO plugins: Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework and Slim SEO. aeoora writes through them and never duplicates schema or meta tags.
  • Page builders: Gutenberg, Classic, Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, Bricks, Oxygen, Breakdance and more.
  • Caches: WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, W3 Total Cache, WP Super Cache, SiteGround, FlyingPress, Cloudflare and others.
  • More: WooCommerce, WPML, Polylang, multisite, SQLite and the WP Consent API.

For developers

WP-CLI (wp aeoora stats|audit|llms|suggest|detect), the WordPress Abilities API for AI agents and MCP (WordPress 6.9+), a REST API and 20+ filters and actions. See the documentation.

External services

aeoora contacts third-party services only for features you turn on or use. Nothing is sent on activation, and there is no telemetry.

AI services

AI is used only after you set one up, and only when you (or the suggestions, if you turn on AI for them) run an AI feature. aeoora then sends the text being worked on (for example a post’s title and content) and your instructions to the service you chose:

  • aeoora Cloud AI: see aeoora Cloud below.
  • WordPress AI (WordPress 7.0+): the request goes through WordPress’s built-in AI Client to the service you connected under Settings → Connectors, under that service’s terms and privacy policy. aeoora never sees its key.
  • An OpenAI-compatible endpoint you enter: the request goes straight from your server to the address you entered in aeoora → Settings → AI, with the key you entered, under your provider’s terms and privacy policy. Load models asks the same address for its list of models.
  • Ollama: the request goes to the Ollama server address you entered (by default localhost, on your own machine).

aeoora Cloud (optional, paid)

aeoora Cloud is a hosted service run by the plugin’s authors at app.aeoora.com (app) and api.aeoora.com (data). It is used only after an administrator opens aeoora Cloud in the plugin’s menu and connects. Nothing is sent before that, and Disconnect stops all sending at once.

  • Connecting with one click: clicking Connect with aeoora Cloud asks https://app.aeoora.com/api/plugin/v1/connect whether one-click connection is available, then opens aeoora Cloud’s connect page in your browser with your site’s address and name, the plugin version, the address to return to in wp-admin, and one-time security values. After you approve, your server sends the one-time code back to https://app.aeoora.com/api/plugin/v1/connect/exchange and receives the connection secret, tracking code and a site token. While connected, opening the aeoora Cloud screen asks https://app.aeoora.com/api/plugin/v1/site for your brand and plan (at most every 10 minutes), and Disconnect tells https://app.aeoora.com/api/plugin/v1/disconnect to revoke the connection.
  • AI-crawler visits: every 10 minutes, a WP-Cron job sends the visits of known AI crawlers (for example GPTBot, ClaudeBot and PerplexityBot) to https://api.aeoora.com/bots/ingest: each visit’s user agent, IP address, page address, HTTP status, time and, if you set AEOORA_TRUST_CLOUDFLARE, Cloudflare’s country code. The full IP is sent so aeoora Cloud can check the crawler against its operator’s published IP ranges, even when the local log anonymizes it. Visits wait in a small table on your site until they are sent, for at most 6 days. Human visitors are never sent. Saving a new secret also sends one empty request to check it.
  • Tracking code: your pages load https://api.aeoora.com/t.js, aeoora Cloud’s tracking script. It reports visits that arrive from AI assistants (the assistant and the landing page) to aeoora Cloud, and sets no cookies.
  • aeoora Cloud AI: only if you choose it under aeoora → Settings → AI (it is chosen for you on connecting only when no other AI is set up). When you run an AI feature, the text being worked on and your instructions are sent to https://app.aeoora.com/api/plugin/v1/ai/complete with the site token, and count toward your plan’s AI credits.
  • Publishing: aeoora Cloud’s Content Agent can send draft posts to your site through the WordPress REST API, and publish them or take them back to draft when you ask it to in aeoora Cloud. This uses an Application Password that you approve in WordPress (during one-click connect) or create and give to aeoora Cloud yourself; a Contributor user limits it to drafts. The plugin itself sends nothing for it.

Terms of service, privacy policy.

IndexNow

Used only if you enable IndexNow (off by default). When you publish or update a post, or click Submit every page now, the URLs and your IndexNow key are sent to api.indexnow.org, which shares them with participating search engines. Terms, Microsoft privacy statement.

Company logos

Logos for 217 companies ship inside the plugin. Only if you click Download missing logos in Settings does aeoora request the icon (/favicon.ico, or /apple-touch-icon.png if there is none) once from each remaining crawler operator’s own website, then store it in wp-content/uploads/aeoora/icons/. No site data is sent.

Links to crawler documentation

The crawler directory shows a link to each crawler operator’s own documentation (for example developer.amazon.com/amazonbot), so you can read what a bot does before you allow or block it. These are plain links for you to open; aeoora never requests them.
sections.installation:
1. In wp-admin go to Plugins → Add New, search for aeoora and click Install Now, then Activate. (Or upload the aeoora folder to /wp-content/plugins/.)
  2. Crawler tracking, AI referral tracking, /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt and .md pages work straight away.
  3. Open aeoora in the admin menu and follow the 2-minute setup. You can skip it at any time.
  4. Optional: connect AI. Use aeoora Cloud AI (after connecting aeoora Cloud), an AI service under Settings → Connectors on WordPress 7.0+, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint in aeoora → Settings → AI (the key can also go in wp-config.php: define( 'AEOORA_KEY_CUSTOM', '…' );).
  5. Optional: if another plugin or file already serves llms.txt, open aeoora → llms.txt & Markdown and click Take over and keep it applied. Tick the box to keep a physical robots.txt in sync too.
  6. Optional: open aeoora → aeoora Cloud and click Connect with aeoora Cloud to track your brand inside AI answers.
sections.faq:
What is AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)?

AEO is optimizing your content so AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Google AI Overviews) can find it, understand it and cite it in their answers. It builds on SEO: crawlability and quality still matter. AI engines also favor answer-first writing, clear question headings, statistics, sources and freshness. aeoora measures all of these. More in What is answer engine optimization?

What is the difference between AEO, GEO, LLMO and AI SEO?

They are different names for the same goal: GEO is “Generative Engine Optimization”, LLMO is “Large Language Model Optimization”, and AI SEO and LLM SEO are informal terms. aeoora covers all of them. See AEO vs GEO vs LLMO.

Is “GEO” here about geolocation?

No. In aeoora, GEO means Generative Engine Optimization: getting cited by AI answer engines. aeoora does not look up visitor locations.

Can aeoora guarantee that ChatGPT or Google will cite my site?

No tool can. AI engines decide what to cite. aeoora removes the technical blockers, shows what AI crawlers and assistants actually do on your site, and tells you what makes a page easier to quote, so your odds go up.

Do I need an account or an API key?

No. Everything works right after activation, without an account. An AI key is needed only for the AI writer and AI-written fixes, and only if you choose your own AI service. aeoora Cloud is optional.

Does it work with MCP and AI agents?

Yes. On WordPress 6.9+, aeoora registers its features with the WordPress Abilities API, so MCP clients and AI agents connected to your site can read stats, run audits and regenerate llms.txt. Every page is also available as Markdown for agents.

Is aeoora really free?

Yes. Every feature in the plugin is free and GPL-licensed, with no paid tier, no credits and no account. AI features use the AI you choose: your own provider (billed by them at their prices), a free local Ollama model, or aeoora Cloud AI if you have an aeoora Cloud plan.

How do I get my site cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity or Google AI Overviews?

Make sure AI search crawlers can reach you (aeoora’s “Get cited, don’t train” preset), make your content easy to quote (answer-first intros, question headings, statistics and sources: the 24-check score shows what is missing), and keep it fresh. aeoora’s daily suggestions turn these into one-click fixes. Our AI search optimization checklist walks through the rest.

How do I create an llms.txt file in WordPress?

Install aeoora. /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt are generated automatically for every page and updated whenever you publish and on a schedule. Edit the summary and sections under aeoora → llms.txt & Markdown. Just want a one-off file? Try the free llms.txt generator.

Another plugin already makes llms.txt. Can aeoora replace it?

Yes. aeoora → llms.txt & Markdown shows when Yoast SEO, Rank Math or a file in your site root serves llms.txt instead of aeoora. Take over and keep it applied turns their llms.txt feature off, moves old files to wp-content/uploads/aeoora/backup/ and re-applies this on every rebuild. Undo takeover restores the files and the other plugin’s setting.

Does it work on large sites?

Yes. There are no page caps: llms.txt lists every page unless you set a limit, and scans, suggestions and IndexNow work through the whole site in small background batches, so no single request runs long.

How do I block GPTBot, ClaudeBot or other AI crawlers?

Open aeoora → AI crawlers. Pick the “Get cited, don’t train” preset, or set any crawler to Disallow (robots.txt) or Block (HTTP 403). Search engines and live AI assistants stay allowed unless you choose otherwise.

Should I block AI training bots?

It is your call. Blocking AI training bots does not remove you from AI search answers, because those use separate crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot). The “Get cited, don’t train” preset sets this up in one click.

How can I see traffic from ChatGPT, Perplexity or Gemini?

Open aeoora → AI referrals. Visitors are grouped by assistant, with the pages they landed on. A small script (about 5 KB, under 2 KB compressed) detects them, so it works behind page caches.

Can I track Google AI Overviews and AI Mode clicks?

Not separately. Clicks from AI Overviews and AI Mode look like ordinary Google search traffic to every analytics tool. aeoora tells you this instead of guessing.

Do I need AI?

No. Crawler tracking, AI referrals, robots.txt control, llms.txt, Markdown, schema, both audits and rule-based suggestions all work without it. The AI writer and one-click AI fixes need one of: aeoora Cloud AI, the AI service connected under Settings → Connectors (WordPress 7.0+), an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or Ollama.

What is aeoora Cloud, and do I need it?

You don’t need it. aeoora Cloud is a separate, optional hosted service with its own paid plans. It follows your brand inside AI answers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews), next to competitors and the sources AI cites, and includes aeoora Cloud AI for the plugin’s AI features. Connecting takes one click and nothing away from the plugin, and you can disconnect at any time.

Will it conflict with Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO?

No. aeoora does not replace your SEO plugin. It writes titles and meta descriptions through it, and only adds schema your SEO plugin does not already output. The only setting it ever changes in another plugin is that plugin’s llms.txt feature, and only when you click Take over.

Does it work with Elementor, Divi and other page builders?

Yes. Builder pages are converted to Markdown and scored from what visitors actually see.

Does it work with page caches and Cloudflare?

Yes. AI referrals are tracked client-side, so caches don’t affect them. llms.txt and Markdown responses are kept out of page caches so AI fetches are always logged. aeoora asks WP Rocket to bypass its cache for blocked bots, and warns you when a CDN or cache serves pages before blocking can apply.

Will it slow down my site?

No. Logging is lightweight and charts read from daily roll-ups. The referral script is small and deferred, and heavy work (llms.txt, scans, suggestions) runs in the background.

Is it GDPR friendly?

Human visitors are counted without cookies or IP addresses, bot IPs are anonymized by default, and the WP Consent API is respected. All data stays in your own database unless you connect the optional aeoora Cloud service (see External services). A suggested privacy-policy paragraph is added to Settings → Privacy.

Does llms.txt actually help?

It is cheap to have and some agents read it, but most AI answer engines rarely request it today. aeoora serves it and weights it low in the audit. Crawlability, answer-first content, statistics, sources and freshness matter far more.

My robots.txt rules don’t show up

A physical robots.txt file in your site root, your host or your CDN can override WordPress. The robots.txt tab shows the live file. Click Sync aeoora rules into robots.txt, or turn on Keep a physical robots.txt in sync, to write them into the file. Or turn off your CDN’s managed robots.txt.

Does it work on multisite?

Yes. Each site has its own settings and analytics. On subdirectory networks crawlers only read the main site’s robots.txt, and aeoora tells you so.

What happens to my data if I uninstall?

Deleting the plugin removes its settings, tables and generated files, leaving nothing behind. Planning to reinstall? Turn on Settings → Data & system → Keep aeoora data when the plugin is deleted first.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • One-click aeoora Cloud connection: click Connect with aeoora Cloud, sign in, pick your brand, and you’re back connected, with no secret or tracking code to copy. Brand and plan show on the screen, and Disconnect also revokes the connection in aeoora Cloud. Manual connection is still available.
  • aeoora Cloud AI: a connected site can run AI Studio, suggestions and AI fixes on aeoora Cloud’s AI, with no key to manage, and see its remaining AI credits.
  • One-click takeover of llms.txt and llms-full.txt: aeoora answers both before other plugins, turns off Yoast SEO’s and Rank Math’s llms.txt, backs up old files and re-checks every 10 minutes. “Check what is served” now reads large static llms-full.txt files correctly. Undo at any time.
  • Sites updated from 1.1.0 move from the old 300 / 100-page limits to every page, unless you changed them.
  • llms.txt and llms-full.txt are rebuilt on a schedule (twice a day by default) as well as after each change, and a physical robots.txt can be kept in sync automatically.
  • No page caps: llms.txt lists every page by default, the content scan scores the whole site in background batches, suggestions can review the whole site, and IndexNow can submit every page.
  • Review and help links on the Plugins screen, and setup, AI Studio and Settings point to aeoora Cloud AI when no AI is set up.

1.1.0

  • AI Studio’s blog writer now writes into a Notion-style editor: click any block to type, press / for headings, lists, quotes and tables, drag blocks to reorder, use Markdown shortcuts, and ask AI to rewrite, expand, shorten, simplify or continue a single block. Your article is saved in the browser until you create the draft.
  • AI uses the WordPress AI Client (Settings → Connectors) on WordPress 7.0+, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or a local Ollama model. No AI service addresses ship in the plugin any more.
  • Fixed “invalid JSON” errors in AI features: replies wrapped in prose or code fences, with raw line breaks or trailing commas, or cut off before the end are now repaired, with one stricter retry; when a host stops a long request, the message says so and the writer retries once.
  • Drafts keep quotes and dividers as native Quote and Separator blocks.
  • Security and compatibility: all request data is sanitized when read, the dashboard widget escapes every value, structured data and post-list styles use the WordPress script and style APIs.

1.0.0

  • Guided 2-minute setup, command-palette shortcuts and a rich WordPress dashboard widget.
  • 325-crawler analytics with ChatGPT Agent detection, live activity feed, crawl log, CSV export and email reports.
  • AI referral tracking for 40 assistants, cache-proof and cookieless.
  • Per-bot Allow / Disallow / Block (403), four presets, Content Signals, physical robots.txt sync and a live robots.txt check.
  • llms.txt, llms-full.txt and Markdown for every page, with builder support and noise removal.
  • Schema without duplicates, FAQ and Key-takeaway blocks, IndexNow.
  • 24-check post score, 18-check site audit, daily one-click suggestions.
  • AI Studio with 47 templates and an editor panel.
  • Accessible, RTL-ready admin that follows your color scheme. Works with the WP Consent API, multisite, SQLite, WP-CLI and the Abilities API.
  • Optional, opt-in connection to the separate aeoora Cloud service.

  • A Markdown version of every page: add .md to any URL (/about.md) or use ?format=markdown. Works with any permalink structure, custom post types, WooCommerce, WPML, Polylang and page builders, and strips widgets, share buttons and ads.
  • Never exposes drafts, private, password-protected, noindex or members-only content.
  • Schema without duplicates: FAQPage, Article, Organization, WebSite and BreadcrumbList. aeoora adds only what your SEO plugin does not already output.
  • FAQ and Key-takeaway blocks (and shortcodes) for answer-ready boxes anywhere.
  • IndexNow for instant indexing in Bing (which powers Microsoft Copilot), Yandex, Seznam and Naver, including “Submit every page now”.

4. Improve every page

  • 24-check AI-answer readiness score for every post and page: answer-first intro, question headings, self-contained sections, lists and tables, statistics, cited sources, attributed quotes, definitions, freshness, author expertise (E-E-A-T), original insight, readability and more. The whole site is scored in the background, in small batches, however many pages you have.
  • 18-check site audit, run against your live site: crawler access, content in the server HTML, sitemap dates, HTTPS, canonical tags, response time, Organization schema, llms.txt, Markdown, IndexNow, Bing and author bios.
  • Suggestions you apply in one click: meta descriptions, SEO titles, answer-first intros, FAQs and a prioritized fix list with the points each fix is worth. Review the whole site in batches, or a set number of pages a day. They work without AI; with AI, your model writes them.
  • AI blog writer in a Notion-style editor: brief → outline → article → a real block-editor draft with meta description and FAQ schema. Press / for blocks, drag to reorder, and ask AI to rewrite, expand or shorten any block. It never invents facts: it leaves [STAT NEEDED] and [SOURCE NEEDED] placeholders.
  • 47 AI templates: AI Overview answers, FAQ generator, “questions people ask AI”, comparison tables, pros and cons, voice answers, product descriptions, social posts, rewrites, translations and more.
  • Editor panel in the block and classic editors, with a live score, FAQ, TL;DR, meta fields and AI buttons.

Step-by-step guides: rank in Google AI Overviews · get recommended by ChatGPT · get cited by Perplexity · AEO for WordPress publishers

Choose your AI, or use none

AI is optional. Pick one under aeoora → Settings → AI:

  • aeoora Cloud AI (when this site is connected to aeoora Cloud): included in your plan, no key to manage.
  • WordPress AI (WordPress 7.0+): the service connected under Settings → Connectors.
  • Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: OpenAI, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Mistral, Groq, xAI, Together, and the OpenAI-compatible addresses of Anthropic and Google Gemini.
  • Local Ollama: free models on your own server.

Keys are encrypted at rest, a daily request limit protects your bill, and broken or cut-off AI replies are repaired automatically.

Optional: aeoora Cloud

The plugin shows what happens on your site. aeoora Cloud is a separate, paid hosted service from the same team that shows what AI answers say about you: brand mentions and recommendations in ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews, share of voice against competitors, cited sources, a Content Agent and team workspaces. See features and pricing.

Connect in one click: click Connect with aeoora Cloud, sign in and pick your brand. You come back connected: AI-crawler visits flow into your verified crawler report, the tracking snippet counts AI-assistant visits, aeoora Cloud AI becomes available, and (if you allow it) WordPress approves an Application Password so drafts can be sent to your site. Disconnect stops everything at once. Nothing is sent before you connect.

Built to feel like WordPress

Accessible (keyboard, screen readers, WCAG AA contrast, reduced motion, RTL), follows your admin color scheme, adds Ctrl/⌘+K shortcuts and is fully translatable. Hard blocks never touch the REST API, AJAX, cron, login, WooCommerce or payment webhooks.

Works with your theme and plugins

  • SEO plugins: Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework and Slim SEO. aeoora writes through them and never duplicates schema or meta tags.
  • Page builders: Gutenberg, Classic, Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, Bricks, Oxygen, Breakdance and more.
  • Caches: WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, W3 Total Cache, WP Super Cache, SiteGround, FlyingPress, Cloudflare and others.
  • More: WooCommerce, WPML, Polylang, multisite, SQLite and the WP Consent API.

For developers

WP-CLI (wp aeoora stats|audit|llms|suggest|detect), the WordPress Abilities API for AI agents and MCP (WordPress 6.9+), a REST API and 20+ filters and actions. See the documentation.

External services

aeoora contacts third-party services only for features you turn on or use. Nothing is sent on activation, and there is no telemetry.

AI services

AI is used only after you set one up, and only when you (or the suggestions, if you turn on AI for them) run an AI feature. aeoora then sends the text being worked on (for example a post’s title and content) and your instructions to the service you chose:

  • aeoora Cloud AI: see aeoora Cloud below.
  • WordPress AI (WordPress 7.0+): the request goes through WordPress’s built-in AI Client to the service you connected under Settings → Connectors, under that service’s terms and privacy policy. aeoora never sees its key.
  • An OpenAI-compatible endpoint you enter: the request goes straight from your server to the address you entered in aeoora → Settings → AI, with the key you entered, under your provider’s terms and privacy policy. Load models asks the same address for its list of models.
  • Ollama: the request goes to the Ollama server address you entered (by default localhost, on your own machine).

aeoora Cloud (optional, paid)

aeoora Cloud is a hosted service run by the plugin’s authors at app.aeoora.com (app) and api.aeoora.com (data). It is used only after an administrator opens aeoora Cloud in the plugin’s menu and connects. Nothing is sent before that, and Disconnect stops all sending at once.

  • Connecting with one click: clicking Connect with aeoora Cloud asks https://app.aeoora.com/api/plugin/v1/connect whether one-click connection is available, then opens aeoora Cloud’s connect page in your browser with your site’s address and name, the plugin version, the address to return to in wp-admin, and one-time security values. After you approve, your server sends the one-time code back to https://app.aeoora.com/api/plugin/v1/connect/exchange and receives the connection secret, tracking code and a site token. While connected, opening the aeoora Cloud screen asks https://app.aeoora.com/api/plugin/v1/site for your brand and plan (at most every 10 minutes), and Disconnect tells https://app.aeoora.com/api/plugin/v1/disconnect to revoke the connection.
  • AI-crawler visits: every 10 minutes, a WP-Cron job sends the visits of known AI crawlers (for example GPTBot, ClaudeBot and PerplexityBot) to https://api.aeoora.com/bots/ingest: each visit’s user agent, IP address, page address, HTTP status, time and, if you set AEOORA_TRUST_CLOUDFLARE, Cloudflare’s country code. The full IP is sent so aeoora Cloud can check the crawler against its operator’s published IP ranges, even when the local log anonymizes it. Visits wait in a small table on your site until they are sent, for at most 6 days. Human visitors are never sent. Saving a new secret also sends one empty request to check it.
  • Tracking code: your pages load https://api.aeoora.com/t.js, aeoora Cloud’s tracking script. It reports visits that arrive from AI assistants (the assistant and the landing page) to aeoora Cloud, and sets no cookies.
  • aeoora Cloud AI: only if you choose it under aeoora → Settings → AI (it is chosen for you on connecting only when no other AI is set up). When you run an AI feature, the text being worked on and your instructions are sent to https://app.aeoora.com/api/plugin/v1/ai/complete with the site token, and count toward your plan’s AI credits.
  • Publishing: aeoora Cloud’s Content Agent can send draft posts to your site through the WordPress REST API, and publish them or take them back to draft when you ask it to in aeoora Cloud. This uses an Application Password that you approve in WordPress (during one-click connect) or create and give to aeoora Cloud yourself; a Contributor user limits it to drafts. The plugin itself sends nothing for it.

Terms of service, privacy policy.

IndexNow

Used only if you enable IndexNow (off by default). When you publish or update a post, or click Submit every page now, the URLs and your IndexNow key are sent to api.indexnow.org, which shares them with participating search engines. Terms, Microsoft privacy statement.

Company logos

Logos for 217 companies ship inside the plugin. Only if you click Download missing logos in Settings does aeoora request the icon (/favicon.ico, or /apple-touch-icon.png if there is none) once from each remaining crawler operator’s own website, then store it in wp-content/uploads/aeoora/icons/. No site data is sent.

Links to crawler documentation

The crawler directory shows a link to each crawler operator’s own documentation (for example developer.amazon.com/amazonbot), so you can read what a bot does before you allow or block it. These are plain links for you to open; aeoora never requests them.
